subject: Re: EU-only processing & private connect — architecture and evidence
messages:
From: Anna Schroeder <anna.schroeder@medisure.de>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@medisure.de
Date: Mon, 9 Feb 2026 08:13:00 +0100
Subject: EU-only processing + private connect request

Hi Sean,

Thanks again for the demo last week. As part of our procurement checklist, MediSure needs a contractual and technical commitment that all customer data for our account will be processed and stored only in EU regions. Specifically we need:

- Confirmation that inference and KV/prefix caching can be confined to EU-based hosts (no cross-border replication or egress to non-EU tenants).
- Option to use Private Connect / VPC peering (or an equivalent private network path) for API traffic so we avoid public internet exposure.
- Evidence bundle for our security review: SCCs assertion, SOC 2 summary, network topology diagram, and a mapping of any third-party subprocessors used within the EU.

Our procurement team will also need a brief architecture diagram and an estimated timeline for completing a private-connect on-boarding. Do you have a standard addendum or template we can review? We’re targeting an internal decision by end of February; procurement also requires that we have documented controls for key management and audit logging.

Happy to share a short questionnaire if that’s easier.

Best,
Anna Schroeder
Head of Security & Compliance
MediSure GmbH

--

Hi Anna — great to hear from you and thanks for the clear checklist.

Short answers up front: yes, we can support EU-only processing for your account and offer Private Connect (VPC peering / AWS PrivateLink / equivalent depending on cloud region). We can provide the SCCs assertion and SOC 2 summary as part of an evidence bundle.

Next steps I propose:
1) I’ll share our EU VPC topology diagram and a short evidence bundle (SCCs + SOC 2 extract) today for your security team to review.
2) Vivek (cc’d) will confirm the data flow and KMS/HSM options and list any subprocessors in-scope.
3) If that looks good we can provide a draft contract addendum and a DocuSign-ready commitment for EU-only processing + private connect.

Could you confirm expected go-live (target date) and whether you require cross-account peering (your own VPC) vs. a private endpoint on our side? That will affect timing — typical onboarding for Private Connect is 3–4 weeks after network validation.

I’ve attached an internal VPC schematic to give you a sense of the architecture.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0199

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:30:00 +0100
Subject: Fwd: EU-only processing — internal notes and evidence

Folks — forwarding Anna’s request with a quick summary of what we can provide and outstanding items.

Summary:
- EU-only processing: Implementable through regional routing (requests anchored to eu-west-1/eu-central-1), strict tenant isolation, and no cross-region backups for this tenant. We offer configurable routing policies to ensure all compute and KV cache stay in-region.
- Private Connect: Support for VPC peering (GCP/VPC), AWS PrivateLink, and Azure Private Link; need to confirm MediSure’s target cloud and networking team contacts.
- KMS/HSM: Customer-managed keys supported (bring-your-own-key integration via KMS + optional HSM-backed signing). We will provide KMS config examples and a key rotation policy extract.
- Audit & Logging: Per-tenant audit logs with export to customer-owned logging endpoints (S3, GCS) and a 90-day retention by default; longer retention is configurable as an add-on.
- Evidence bundle: attached "sccs-evidence-bundle.zip" (contains SCCs self-assertion PDF, SOC 2 summary, subprocessors list), and "data-flow-map.csv" for mapping PII flows.

Outstanding asks from Anna: clarify whether they require a contractual clause that prevents any temporary cross-region failover in emergencies (we can offer a contract-level regional-fencing clause but it has operational caveats re: DR).

Action items:
- Sean: get MediSure’s target cloud + networking contact.
- Monica: prepare draft addendum (EU-only processing + Private Connect) and run pricing impact with sales ops.
- I’ll pull the SCCs/self-assertion and upload Drive link (done) and prepare a short technical FAQ for the onboarding call.

Attachments included: sccs-evidence-bundle.zip, data-flow-map.csv

Vivek Kulkarni
Principal Solutions Security Engineer
Redwood Inference

Cc: procurement@medisure.de, security@medisure.de
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 16:41:00 +0100
Subject: Re: EU-only processing + private connect request

Hi Sean / team — thanks for the quick responses and the attachments. I’ve shared the SCCs and SOC 2 extract with our internal security reviewers; the topology diagram looks sensible. A few follow-ups:

- Procurement asks for a signed addendum that includes the EU-only processing commitment and production-level Private Connect SLA. Can you share a draft addendum and a DocuSign link?
- For DR: we cannot accept automatic cross-region failover that would move production data outside the EU. We are open to a manual, documented DR process that requires written approval from MediSure legal/security before cross-region activation. Please confirm whether you can accept that constraint and we’ll include it in the addendum.
- Please schedule a 45-minute technical onboarding call with your networking/security engineers and our cloud team next week (availability: Mon 16 Feb morning CET or Tue 17 Feb afternoon CET).

If you can provide the draft addendum and the DocuSign link this week, procurement can proceed with the PO.

Best regards,
Anna Schroeder
Head of Security & Compliance
MediSure GmbH
